rationale: After reaching a 0.83% maximum favorable excursion (~$73.71), UNM failed to reach the session low and has reversed higher through the 5-minute 9-EMA ($74.10) to nearly erase the unrealized gain. With 1-minute candles printing consecutive higher highs and lows into the final 41 minutes of a strong broad-market session (SPY +1.77%), the breakdown momentum has stalled and closing preserves capital.
